headline: Tashkent reports changes to procedure for issuing electronic permits for freight transport to China
summary: Uzbekistan's Ministry of Transport changed the procedure for electronic permits for road freight transport to China. Permits will now be issued on request, and carriers are urged to apply only when needed.
why: Road freight permits govern cross-border trucking, which affects the cost and speed of trade between Central Asia and China.
